verdict.rationale: Clerky documents that it logs every change made to a document set or workspace so admins can see who did what, which is a basic audit-log capability, but there is no mention of tamper-evidence (e.g., cryptographic sealing, hash-chained logs) or of a signing completion certificate being issued for executed documents. Missing for 10: tamper-evident/cryptographic audit trail mechanics, completion certificate artifact, and any independent verification of these claims.
